about_the_game:
You are the hunter. You have 90 seconds to hunt as many chicken as possible.

It all started 25 years ago with "The Original Moorhuhn Hunt". With tens of millions games, this easy-to-play but hard-to-master fun shooter is one of the evergreen games in the gaming world.

Finally, you can enjoy this Moorhuhn classic, also known as Crazy Chicken and Chicken Hunter, featuring the wildest and most famous chicken in the world on modern devices. It’s time to restore peace and order! Step into the shoes of the chicken hunter. Move the screen left and right to find more chickens. Aim and shoot quickly to take down all the flying birds. The harder they are to hit, the more points you score!

Get ready for an even more exciting experience! We've combined two Training Areas into the game, allowing you to sharpen your aiming and shooting skills while you're not playing the main game.

The Original Moorhuhn Hunt is a great way to kill a few minutes or spend a few hours while challenging other players worldwide. The hunting season is open!
